_comment: Rows 634 and 639. Every anchor is an exact-once zero-width structural lookahead -- a for statement, an if statement -- so row 357 freezes no re-derived value. M1 restores the bare walk at the operator's boundary and must be caught BEHAVIOURALLY (a 500 instead of JSON); M2 restores one in a module no behavioural test in this band drives, so only the tree-wide census can catch it -- that pair is the argument for having both. M3 and M4 disable the fork hook at two different depths and are caught by two different seams. M5 is the overcorrection: protecting every lock unconditionally keeps the fork behaviour and destroys the exactness. The separate transform-control spec applies M3's byte-identical mutation to an import-only node and must ESCAPE.
subject: no reader walks the live runners registry bare, and a forked child can take every runner lock a scanned route takes
